description: Central shared offline runtime libraries repository for GazBoard and Antigravity applications

libraries.name: KaTeX
libraries.description: Fast math typesetting engine for TeX / LaTeX mathematical notations, equations, and structures.

libraries.name: PDF.js Core
libraries.description: Mozilla PDF document parser, text layer extractor, and page rendering engine.

libraries.name: pdf-lib
libraries.description: Pure JavaScript library to modify existing PDFs, expand page margins, edit metadata, and embed native annotations.

libraries.name: JSZip
libraries.description: ZIP container creation, compression, and extraction for .gazboard single-file bundle packages.

libraries.name: Mammoth .docx Converter
libraries.description: Converts Microsoft Word (.docx) documents into clean HTML and formatted cards.

libraries.name: Mermaid.js
libraries.description: Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, mind maps, and decision trees.

libraries.name: Chart.js
libraries.description: HTML5 Canvas charting engine for Radar/Spider, Bar, Line, Doughnut, and Scatter charts.

libraries.name: 3Dmol.js
libraries.description: High-performance WebGL 3D molecular viewer rendering ball-and-stick, CPK space-filling, and secondary structures from PDB and SDF files.

libraries.name: Nerdamer CAS
libraries.description: Pure JavaScript symbolic math engine supporting symbolic differentiation, polynomial factoring, equation solving, and matrix calculations.

libraries.name: Function Plot
libraries.description: Dynamic 2D mathematical function grapher supporting derivatives, tangent slopes, and definite integral shading.

libraries.name: Math.js
libraries.description: Extensive math library for JavaScript and Node.js featuring arbitrary precision arithmetic, complex numbers, matrices, and engineering units.

libraries.name: MP4 Muxer
libraries.description: Pure JavaScript MP4 (ISOBMFF) container muxer enabling direct fast client-side MP4 video generation without external FFmpeg binaries.
